  + API: fix PlayTime toolbar addition when toolbar is not already customized

v7.78 - July 18 2026
  + API: ignore midi_reinit() (and related others) when incorrectly called by certain extensions in other threads
  + API: improve performance of PlayTrackPreview/StopTrackPreview, defer global lock/routing reanalysis if called multiple times within a short window
  + ARA: apply the final item gain (zero, if item is faded out) to ARA plugin output after the end of the media item being processed
